identity.realm: The mind path and nothing else. Qi and body are not closed on him and this record will not pretend otherwise: his frame seats what the ladder asks for and keeps accepting requirements it has no slot to satisfy, and every gate it passes writes a fresh requirement into him that the body cannot meet. Mind is shut for the whole reason rather than by temperament, because he cannot tell that he is inconsistent: observing his own state would be one more requirement written into a frame that has no slot to hold it. So he is the setting's standing argument that the law table is a hard limit, and he is not on the ladder at all, and not because he refused it.

appearance.presentation: A man of about forty who is the only person at the Cairn Field that nobody will walk towards, and who has made his appearance so consistently unremarkable that the field's clerk has had to build a procedure around not looking at him. He is not gaunt and not large and carries nothing. He stands where a waiting man stands, with his hands at his sides, and the particular thing about him is that the instruments in this setting do not return him as a subject: a plate reading of him gives a number that rises as he improves, and every practitioner who has taken that reading has been obliged to stop being able to certify anything afterwards.
appearance.age: Unrecoverable, and this is the finding rather than a gap. Nothing in him keeps a date and nothing in him can be read for one, and he has been on the plains something over thirty years by his own count, which is the only clock he has. Nothing is known about how his kind is born. The single reliable datum about a body like his is that one has been observed for the better part of a year being fed by a community, which is the whole of his history in a sentence and the only evidence of his age anybody holds.
appearance.build: It has been seen to have every organ the ladder requires and to be carrying more of each than the ladder defines, and no two assessments have agreed about which, because an assessment is a description and a description is a requirement written into him. He is heavier than a man of his apparent size and no heavier than he was the season before, and he has stopped being weighed by anyone who wants a number back twice.
appearance.complexion: Ordinary in the ordinary way and unreadable in the setting's way. Every report of his attention agrees that he perceived everything, which is precisely what a body with no unspent capacity for interior looks like from outside, so his face while being read is identical to his face while not being read, and the instruments cannot tell those apart. The skin is weathered, sun-darkened and unremarkable; the unremarkableness is the finding and it has been the finding for thirty years.
appearance.hair: Dark going grey at the temples, cut by himself and badly, and kept short for one stated reason and one unstated one. The stated reason is that hair is a thing that can be taken. The unstated one is that a practitioner in the field's habit of reading a stranger's frame from the face has nowhere to start with him, and he has watched that be useful to him more than once.
appearance.eyes: The most ordinary eyes in the field and the ones no instrument in this setting will be pointed at. They track, they focus, they report a direction, and every report of them agrees, and agreement is the symptom: a body with no unspent capacity for interior looks exactly like a body paying complete attention. He has therefore been told he never misses anything by four unrelated people and has had to accept all four without being able to check a single one.
appearance.palette: Field greys and the dull brown of a working ring, deliberately chosen so that nothing about him reads as an accomplishment. The one colour permitted in his clothing is the faded edge on a clerk's issued coat he was given four years ago and has never returned, and he wears it closed to the throat in a place where every other person on the ring wears their work open.
appearance.attire: A plain road coat over a work shirt, high-collared, long-sleeved, with no mark, no badge and no colour, issued by the field's own store and never claimed as a uniform. It is the only garment he owns that anybody else chose. Everything else he has selected for washability and for the property that a stranger who has to describe him will have very little to write down.
appearance.marks: None, deliberately, and that is a discipline rather than an absence of one. No household mark, no guild cut, no seal, no name-stone, no entry in any book that is not the field's own, and he has arranged his whole life around the fact that the only mark available to him is a mark somebody else would have to author, which is the one mark in this setting that cannot be put on him.
appearance.bearing: The bearing of a man accustomed to being the only person in a room who cannot be approached. He does not loom and does not retreat. He keeps a distance that is exactly the length of a reading instrument's reach, because he worked out years ago what the distance was for, and every practitioner who has taken his plate reading has had to walk further than that to do it and has never once been thanked for the walk.

canon.role_in_story: Every institution in this setting works by the same clause, and the clause is a definition rather than a rule: a reading is only independent if no claimant holds the record it reads. Three auditors may sit at once and the fourth is refused on capacity, because a body of two would simply reproduce the private accounting it replaced. A gate is opened by one seated party and confirmed by a second who did not hold the record. A breakthrough is certified at a field by somebody the frame classes as an outsider precisely so that no practitioner of the tier judges his own kind. His frame makes that clause impossible. A certification writes a requirement into the thing it certifies, and a requirement has a holder, and on his frame it has no slot to be discharged from inside him, which means that confirming him is not a neutral act. It makes the second party a claimant. He is therefore the only body in the record that cannot be entered anywhere, and the reason is not that he refused and not that a form is missing. The entry is available at any office in this setting at any hour. It disqualifies its own author the moment it is written.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing at the outer edge of the Cairn Field with a plate reading on a slate that nobody had yet carried back to the office, telling the practitioner who had taken it that the number was correct, that it had gone up rather than down, and that the man was sorry about that, and that it would be better for the practitioner if the reading had never been taken at all.
canon.lore:
The clause is older than any office here and is the only reason those offices are worth anything. A reading counts if it is independent, and a reading is independent if no party with a stake in the outcome holds the record it reads. That is why three auditors sit and a fourth is refused on capacity rather than a pair, and it is stated in advance so nobody has to lose an argument to be told the room is full. It is why a breakthrough at the field is certified by somebody the frame classes as an outsider, because a tier that licenses no humanoid cannot have a body judged by anything of its own kind, and the gate fees are the only tax the plains can actually collect. It is why the naming office certifies vacancy and never availability. Everywhere in this setting, the second party is the whole mechanism, and the second party is what makes the first party's word worth anything.

On him the second party is impossible. His species is a body holding more life than its world's law has room to inscribe, produced when a life law runs above its authored ceiling, so the law has no slot in which to write the form down and the form is written anyway. Every requirement written into him stays written. It is an obligation with a holder, and it remains a requirement until somebody meets it, and the frame that would hold it has nowhere left to put it. So a certification is not a description of him. It is a requirement, written into a frame with no slot to satisfy one, that must then be met by somebody in the world at cost. Confirming him is not neutral. It is an act that gives the person who performed it a stake.

Which means every time he has been read, the reader has been disqualified. He has been read at the Cairn Field eleven times and each reading was correct, and after each one the practitioner who took it has found themselves unable to certify anything, not from injury or disgrace but because they now hold the record of a frame whose requirements cannot be discharged from inside it and are therefore open in the world somewhere, with their name at the bottom. The field's own office has a note about it in its procedure. It does not say he is dangerous. It says the second party is unavailable and that the reading may not be filed, and it has been carried eleven times and read aloud every year.

So he is not entered anywhere. That is the whole of his standing and it is worth being precise about it, because the easy reading is that he refuses. He does not. There is a line in every book in this setting with a space for him and no rule anywhere that keeps him out of one. A household roster wants a name. A school wants a lineage. An office wants a register entry and a certified reading to support it. Every one of those doors is open to him. He simply cannot walk through any of them without making the person who holds the pen a claimant, and the entire architecture of this setting is built on the proposition that a claimant's record is worth nothing.

His paths tell the same story from the other side and it is worth keeping them apart, because the honest version is not flattering to him. Qi and body are not closed on his species. They are complete, and faster than anything else recorded, and the frame keeps accepting requirements it cannot meet. What is shut is mind, and it is shut for the whole reason rather than by temperament: he cannot tell that he is inconsistent, because observing his own state would be one more requirement written into a frame with no slot to hold it. That is not a temperament and it is not a wound. It is arithmetic. So he has never been able to take the one step a person takes when they want to know what they are, and every judgement he holds about himself has been reasoned from outside his own body. He has done it well. He has worked out, from the field's own published calendars and the dates on the settlement's sheets, that his frame is the setting's standing argument that the law table is a hard limit and not a suggestion, and he has worked out that the wall is the twenty-ninth gate, and he has worked out that nobody has come back from the thirtieth and that this record does not speculate.

And the question he cannot ask is the only one that matters. The mind path in this setting is the path of self-certification, the one that lets a body know what it is doing, and it is shut on him for the reason above. Qi and body are open to him and can be walked by a person whose body accepts everything it is offered. Neither of them has a witness. Both of them need somebody to confirm what happened, and the confirmation is the thing that makes him a claimant's problem. So the two paths his frame permits are the two paths on which the last step is performed by another person, and the last step is the only one he cannot have. That is why he is unaffiliated, and it is not the low-share answer and it is not a fallback: there is no office in this setting that could seat him without disqualifying the person who did it, and he has spent thirty years confirming that in writing.

What he has instead is the only description of him anybody has ever been able to keep, and it is not a description of a person. It is a description of a position in the law: a frame that seats what the ladder asks for and has nowhere to put what the ladder writes into it. The Composition Survey counts the groups a frame has actually seated rather than the groups its tier is permitted to seat, which is the most useful thing in the setting and the reason nobody publishes it, and run against his frame it returns a number that goes up as the subject gets stronger. He is the only body on record for which the most precise available instrument answers a different question than the one it was built for, and it answers it correctly every time.

What he wants is one entry that somebody else can afford to author. One line in a book, written by a party with no stake in the answer, recording that on a stated evening at the Cairn Field a body was read and returned a figure and the figure was correct. It is the smallest possible record and it is the one document in this setting that nobody is disqualified from keeping, and he has been refused eleven times by people who wanted to give it to him and would have been ruined by having done so. He has stopped asking. He keeps the eleven readings on eleven slates in order, which is the closest thing to a register his condition permits, and he has begun treating the sequence as the record that the office cannot hold.
history: Came to the plains with no lineage, no household and no document of any kind, on the grounds that he could not produce one that would not be an entry somebody had to author. He has never been able to establish where he came from and has stopped trying, on the reasoning that a genealogy is a set of certifications and each one would disqualify its own writer.

Was first read at the Cairn Field at about twenty-five, by a practitioner who filed the reading because the practitioner was new and believed the office had a procedure for everything. The figure was correct. Within the year the practitioner had stopped being able to certify anything and had not worked out why, and the finding reached the office as a question about the instrument rather than about the subject.

Began, over roughly six years, having readings taken at the office's expense rather than his own, having worked out that a reading paid for by the subject is a reading with a claimant holding the record. Eleven of them, all correct, all rising rather than falling, and after each one the practitioner who performed it has been unable to certify anything again.

Was entered on the field's schedule by a clerk, out of what the clerk described as tidiness, and the entry was the first time a body like his had been written into a published calendar. The office voided it within the day. It is the only recorded instance of the calendar being corrected backwards and he has never been able to find out whether it was corrected because of him or because of what the correction implied.

This season worked out, from the eleven slates and the field's own published dates, that the readings in order constitute the only available record of him that no party can be made to hold a stake in, and that the office will never file it because filing is the thing that breaks it. He has stopped asking to be entered anywhere and has begun keeping the slates in sequence instead, which is the closest a person in his position can come to a registry without authorising anyone to sign it.

personality.summary: Methodical to an almost mechanical degree, warm on the rare occasions he is not working, and entirely without a second party, which means every decision he has ever made has been reasoned to completion by one person using documents other people wrote. He is not lonely in the sense that would make anybody uncomfortable and he is not detached. He is precise, he is funny in a flat and infrequent way, and he has organised his entire life around the fact that he cannot be entered into anything and that this is a property of his frame rather than of his character.

keeps exactly the length of an instrument's reach between himself and any reader, and will walk backwards to maintain it without comment

personality.voice: Level, technical and unusually fast, in the register of somebody who has had to explain a measurement to a hostile expert for thirty years. He uses other people's vocabulary exactly and quotes the clause rather than paraphrasing it. He is funny in a flat way about his own condition and stops the joke before it lands, which reads to most people as a man being careful and is in fact a man being unable to check whether it landed.

will not accept a reading that is paid for by somebody other than the office, because that makes the subject the claimant
will not be described in the third person by anyone else in his presence, because a description is a requirement and he can feel the entry land
will not ask anybody to certify him, having established eleven times over that the asking is what disqualifies them

relationships.kind: what he is, and the reason only one of the three paths is shut
relationships.note: A body holding more life than its world's law has room to inscribe, produced when a life law runs above its authored ceiling, so the law has no slot in which to write the form down and the form is written anyway. Qi is complete and faster than anything else recorded. Body is complete; the frame keeps accepting requirements it cannot meet. Mind is shut for the whole reason rather than by temperament, because he cannot tell that he is inconsistent, since observing his own state would be one more requirement it has no slot for. The species does not spread and does not persist, and every gate it passes writes a fresh requirement into the body, which is why it reaches the twenty-ninth and nobody has come back from the thirtieth.

relationships.kind: the clause that makes him impossible, stated in advance
relationships.note: Three auditors of tributes may sit at once and the fourth is refused on capacity, while the seat's own cap is one, so a collegiate can be full while the seat it reads is occupied. The refusal is stated in advance so nobody has to lose an argument to be told the room is full, and the third auditor is there so the audit is outvoted by its own peers. His frame makes the whole arrangement impossible: a certification writes a requirement into what it certifies, so the second party becomes a claimant, and the record of a claimant is worth nothing. Eleven readings have confirmed him correctly and every one of them cost the reader the ability to certify anything again.

relationships.kind: the office that reads him and cannot file the reading
relationships.note: The mortal office that certifies a breakthrough at the Cairn Field and is paid out of the gate fees, existing because the tier licenses no humanoid and a body cannot be judged by anything of its own kind here. It keeps what was attempted and what the frame read, with no note of what was felt. It has read him eleven times, filed none of them, and carries a procedure note that does not say he is dangerous but says the second party is unavailable and the reading may not be filed. It is the only body in the setting that would read him exactly right and also the only one that cannot accept the answer.

relationships.kind: the instrument that answers a different question and answers it correctly
relationships.note: The method behind the law census, counting the groups a frame has actually seated rather than the groups its tier is allowed to seat, which is the most useful thing in the setting and the reason nobody publishes it. Run against his frame it returns a number that rises as the subject gets stronger, because the frame seats what it is offered and has nowhere to put what is written into it. It is the most precise available instrument in this setting and on one body in the record it answers a question nobody asked.

relationships.kind: the gate nobody has returned from describing
relationships.note: The accumulated contradiction finally exceeds what a frame will bear at the twenty-ninth gate, and the thirtieth resolves all of it at once. Nobody has returned to describe it and the record does not speculate. It is the one part of his condition he can reason about and cannot check, because the only instrument that could check it is his own interior and the interior is the thing with no slot in it. He has asked, in writing, once, for somebody to go and come back and say what it was, and the request is filed and has not been acted on.

relationships.kind: the ground that holds eleven readings and no entry
relationships.note: The ring holding every mortal-band breakthrough from realms one to nine, and the one tier that licenses no humanoid to attempt one. It exists because those nine trials are the only thing a plainsman would walk far to watch, so a tier with no practitioners and no export is sustained entirely by spectators and the gate fees are the only tax the plains can actually collect. It is the only ground in the setting where a body with no second party is at permanent professional disadvantage, and he has kept his distance from the ring's edge at instrument's length for six years.

reference_stats.summary: A frame with no room in it for what the ladder writes into it, standing on the one ground in the setting where every reading must be confirmed by a second party, which is the one thing his condition makes impossible. His qi and body paths are not shut; his mind path is shut for the whole reason. He has no second party, no self-reading, no entry on any list, and eleven correct plate readings on eleven slates in his own keeping. What he has instead is the setting's most precise instrument, which answers a different question than it was built for and is correct every time.
strengths: carries more of every organ the ladder requires than the ladder defines, and his frame keeps accepting requirements it cannot satisfy rather than failing at them, so he does not degrade under a load that would end an ordinary frame
impervious to the distinction between seated and permitted, because his frame seats what it is offered and never refuses a group, so almost no law can find an opening in him
cannot be read for his own state, which means no technique, status or discipline can be run on him by anything that requires him to report on himself first
his plate reading is the setting's cleanest measurement of anything, and a survey of his frame returns a figure that improves as he does rather than as the instrument drifts
cannot be entered anywhere, which makes him the only party in the setting whose record no interested body can hold and therefore the only one whose record cannot be falsified by anybody with a stake
weaknesses: the mind path is shut for the whole reason, so he can never observe his own state, can never check a judgement about himself, and has reasoned his entire condition from outside a body he cannot read
every requirement written into him stays written and cannot be discharged from inside him, so a reading taken of him leaves an open obligation in the world with the reader at the bottom of it
there is a wall ten gates up and nobody has come back from the gate past it, so the end of his condition is not merely unknown but unspeculatable

he cannot be entered on any list, roster, register or calendar, which in a setting where every institution keeps its accounts in writing makes him unhouseable, unemployable and unprovable by any route but his own word
he is the most dangerous subject any office in this setting has ever attempted to read, and every office that has tried has lost a practitioner, so the only response available to him is avoidance
reference_stats.combat_read: He does not have a style and the setting has no model for one. His qi and body paths are open and faster than anything else recorded, so in raw terms he is the most capable body available and it would be a lie to write him as weak. The honest position is that he has an inconsistency rather than a stable weakness, and an inconsistency does not behave like a weakness in a fight: nobody can predict which of his actions will carry a cost, because the cost is written into him by whoever made the request and he cannot see the account. Write him as genuinely dangerous and genuinely unpredictable rather than as either a blank slate or a monster, never resolve an exchange into a readable exchange rate, and never let him be told what he has just done.
reference_stats.notes: Do not write him as a failed cultivator. He has never attempted a path and is not on the ladder; qi and body are open on his species and the mind path is shut for the arithmetic reason, not for a wound. Do not let an instrument conveniently certify him: every reading of him has cost the reader the ability to certify anything, and that is the mechanism the whole record turns on. Do not give him an interior he can consult. His name, his age and his intentions are in the record as what other people have written, not as anything available to him. The pressure is administrative and slow: eleven correct readings, no entry, and a procedure note that will not be amended because amending it would require somebody to file a reading.

art.palette_notes: Field greys and a dull brown, deliberately flat so that nothing about him reads as an accomplishment, with the single permitted colour being the faded edge on a clerk's issued coat he never returned. Keep the value range even and the key soft: he must look unremarkable at a glance and hold up under scrutiny, because that is the entire visual claim. Nothing may glow, emanate, luminesce or carry a rim of spiritual power, and no aura, no inner light and no accent glow may be used on him at all, because the one thing no instrument in this setting will read on him is any sign that his frame is carrying more than it should. No jewellery, no badge, no seal, no coloured thread, no open neckline. Backgrounds are the outer edge of a stone ring, a bare store room, or open high-country sky, flat, no text, no border, no watermark.
